_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 22: 2025-08-19 to 2025-08-30. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He says the sheep and the goats are being divided, that those who stand with Israel are blessed and those who curse it cursed, and that he saw major earthquakes happening in the areas of those who do not stand.
mentions.quote: I saw major earthquakes happening in these areas
mentions.condition_text: the earthquakes fall on nations that fail to stand with Israel
mentions.falsify_match: Major earthquakes striking states that recognised Palestine, and not others.

mentions.claim_text: He notes Trump has decided to speak at the UN again on 23 September, the beginning of Rosh Hashanah, says that is not a coincidence, and wonders what the speech will be about with Macron having just acted.
mentions.quote: On the 23rd of September, the beginning of Rashishana. Okay, the 23rd
mentions.falsify_match: The UN address happening on that date, which was already scheduled.

mentions.claim_text: He points to a major eclipse coming in a week or two and to Trump saying they are not going to poke the bear.
mentions.quote: we have this major eclipse going to come
mentions.time_phrase: a week and a half away
mentions.falsify_match: A real astronomical date, so the premise is fixed; the significance is not.

mentions.claim_text: He says people need to know they are planning on a lot of death and a lot of people dying, not on how everyone will thrive, asking how you burn everybody if they are dead.
mentions.quote: they're planning on a lot of death
mentions.falsify_match: Evidence of a depopulation plan among named actors.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such evidence, and no actors are named.

mentions.claim_text: Asked about a September rapture he says plainly that he personally does not believe it is coming in September, and that he believes instead there is a harvest of souls.
mentions.quote: I personally do not believe it's coming in September
mentions.falsify_match: No rapture in September 2025, which is what happened.
mentions.falsify_miss: A rapture in September 2025 would have falsified it.

mentions.claim_text: He relays that someone believed the rapture or something major would happen in the window from the end of 23 September into about 3 October.
mentions.quote: He believed the rapture of the church, something major is going to happen
mentions.falsify_match: Not his claim; someone else's dated rapture window that he reports without endorsing.

mentions.claim_text: He says explicitly that this is not him being prophetic and telling them when he thinks the Lord is coming, only what has been spoken through the channel about the window given.
mentions.quote: It's not me being prophetic right now, telling you that I think that
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and worth recording: he marks the boundary between his own reasoning and a word.

mentions.claim_text: He says he has an expectation for this month and that it may be when Adam's lease comes up, calling people to pray for the nations and be a light rather than blend in.
mentions.quote: this is the Adam's lease wou
mentions.falsify_match: The transition he calls Adam's lease occurring in September 2025.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord showed him an acceleration of war that would really kick off as they try to take over Gaza, with an escalation and surprise attacks like October 7th.
mentions.quote: I saw surprise like October 7th attacks
mentions.falsify_match: A surprise mass casualty attack on Israel following the Gaza operation.

mentions.claim_text: He says Turkey will be involved in the days ahead, and that he saw those soldiers marching again with red hats.
mentions.quote: I saw those foot those those soldiers marching again with red hats
mentions.falsify_match: Turkish military involvement in the regional war.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is all hands on deck and that people should not assume God will use the pastor's son or daughter instead of them or that they are not qualified.
mentions.quote: it's all hands on deck
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: exhortation.

mentions.claim_text: He says God did not kill those children, the devil did, that believers will rise up and pray, and that there could be children coming back today because they must believe bigger.
mentions.quote: there there could be kids come back today
mentions.falsify_match: A documented resurrection of a child.
mentions.falsify_miss: None documented, and the belief condition absorbs it.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are coming into the best part of the year and are on the victory side, naming September and the Jewish feast days, October, Thanksgiving and Christmas.
mentions.quote: We're coming into the best part of the year
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it sits oddly against the September warnings in the same period.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord acknowledges it may feel dry right now in the natural in the body of Christ, but that the glory is what is happening right now regardless of what is seen.
mentions.quote: You may say it's dry right now in the natural
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and structurally so: dryness is pre-explained as not counting against the outpouring.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw new fresh faces and a fresh revival coming to a particular church, with the Lord warning him that he is not done and that the church could be totally on fire.
mentions.quote: I saw a new fresh faces new fresh revival coming to this church
mentions.falsify_match: A revival at the named church, though the church is not identified here.

mentions.claim_text: He relays a word from someone that right before the end the children would start to intercede and hold intercessory prayer, and says it excited him because that is what they are seeing.
mentions.quote: the end of the end, that the that that the children would start to intercede
mentions.falsify_match: A visible children's prayer movement.

mentions.claim_text: He says an elder told him to do exactly what he is told and stay on track, and that he follows the voice even if it is not the most popular or most anointed crowd.
mentions.quote: It may not be the popularest crowd
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: framing.

mentions.claim_text: He tells viewers down to their last five dollars to believe for their financial breakthrough, resting on the promise of supply according to his riches in glory.
mentions.quote: I want you today to believe for your financial breakthrough
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: private provision with a belief condition.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Lord saying heaven and earth are going to collide, that in one moment everything he has ever desired and the greatest harvest of souls comes, and everything changes in a twenty four hour period.
mentions.quote: Heaven and earth are going to collide
mentions.falsify_match: A single moment producing the greatest harvest of souls.
mentions.falsify_miss: None, and no date is attached.

mentions.claim_text: He says he will pray for people rather than be their friend when they will not have it, that he catches persecution from all kinds of people and that the world hates him.
mentions.quote: I'm going to pray for you instead
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: framing.

mentions.claim_text: He says he does not go to church to be spiritually fed and that waiting for Sundays and Wednesdays to supply it would leave him short, though the gathering refreshes.
mentions.quote: I don't go to our church to get spiritually fed
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: teaching.

mentions.claim_text: He says they find it for themselves and are scavengers, comparing it to old gumbo that looks like it came out of a ditch but is going to be good.
mentions.quote: we find it for oursel. We're scavengers
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: teaching.

mentions.claim_text: He describes yielding to the Holy Ghost tugging through the day, when it is time to listen, put some word on and read the Bible, and that the more you yield the more it comes.
mentions.quote: that tugging saying, Okay, it's time to listen
mentions.condition_text: conditioned on yielding to the prompting
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: teaching.

mentions.claim_text: He notes student loan repayments restarting after nearly two years of pause and mortgage forbearance running three or four months for some people.
mentions.quote: they're just now starting to kick that back in
mentions.falsify_match: Current conditions he cites, not a forward claim.

mentions.claim_text: He points to the 24th and that whole week as not a coincidence, and to a blood moon on 7 September that will be seen by seven billion people, correcting his own earlier confusion of the date with July.
mentions.quote: blood moon that will be seen by 7 billion people on the 7th of September
mentions.falsify_match: A real eclipse date, and he corrects his own mistake about it on air.

mentions.claim_text: He prays search me and know me, saying he is not rotten at the core, may have a bad day but does not stay in it, and chooses to follow Jesus on the mountain or in the valley.
mentions.quote: I may have a bad day, but I don't stay in that bad day
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: personal prayer.

mentions.claim_text: He says that when the Lord took him to the tribulation on 6 July 2014 it shook him for the rest of his life, that he had glimpses of it and walked with Jesus through it.
mentions.quote: I went to tribulation with the Lord on on July the 6th of 2014
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: the founding experience the whole corpus rests on.

mentions.claim_text: He tells viewers to do a gut search and a heart search, asking whether they know Jesus and whether there is compromise in their life, because millions do not know.
mentions.quote: Do I know Jesus? Is there compromise in my life?
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an appeal.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord is protecting the gift inside him from compromise because he is going to use him greatly in the days ahead, and that it can feel lonely and abandoned.
mentions.quote: I've got to protect that gift inside you because I'm going to use you greatly
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a personal commission.
